title: MaterialColor
description: A canonical colour: linear sRGB with straight alpha, each channel a float in [0, 1]. Linear sRGB is chosen because it is what Blender's Principled BSDF `base_color` expects, so no colour-space conversion happens at the Blender boundary — the same reasoning that makes METERS and RADIANS canonical. A colour NAME ('warm beige') is never representable here: names are interpreted above the worker and arrive as explicit validated numbers. JSON cannot encode NaN/Infinity, so the finite rule is additionally enforced by the validation layer.
